scope: Complete beta-shifted Green-frame reconstruction, explicitly collapsed to ordinary mixed-radix Cooley–Tukey. The word exact describes the algebraic map; the implementation uses complex128 FFTs.
line_evidence: 36–44 validation; 47–84 batched summaries and demixing; 92–106 collapsed transform; 109–119 separate decoders; 139–150 ledger.
guards: Q>=2, M>=1, M divides Q, K>=M and a a nonzero unit modulo Q. Shape checked for supplied summaries. collapsed helper omits positive-M/empty-input guards and can divide by zero at M=0. Root/chirp conventions depend on exact matched composite_cycle_core bytes.
actual_cost: Joint path uses M K-FFTs and 3K M-transforms, O(Q log K+Q log M) plus O(Q) phases/storage. Collapsed path uses M K-FFTs plus K M-FFTs. Naive frame pays M full Q-length scans, Theta(QM+Q log K), as its own ledger states.
assessment: Useful complete-frame equivalence, not a sub-QlogQ transform and not an exact-arithmetic runtime certificate. No finite/nonfinite checks or uniform floating error guarantee.

scope: Five-command local regression and benchmark launcher, rather than a mathematical certificate.
line_evidence: 5–10 explicit commands; 12–15 cwd choice and check=True.
guards: Uses current Python executable, fixed relative local scripts, and fail-fast subprocess exit status. OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS is only setdefault, so an existing value is retained. No timeout or assert-enabled requirement.
actual_cost: Sum of all tests, exact finite-field certificate, benchmark, and two inherited verification scripts; launcher overhead is negligible but no linear or sub-FFT runtime follows.
assessment: Running or importing this top-level module would execute other supplied programs; it was only read. Runtime dependency closure includes finite_field_polyphase_certificate.py, benchmark.py and phase4_source verifiers. Stored run_all.log is historical evidence, not a fresh run or cryptographic execution attestation.

scope: Unit tests for batched polyphase summaries, exact-map floating comparisons, collapse equivalence and one delegated finite-field certificate.
line_evidence: 18–50 floating comparisons at listed sizes and tolerances; 52–59 ledger/certificate tests; 61–65 stored phase4 JSON presence test.
guards: Fixed seeded vectors, specified small/moderate Q and M, and imported implementation guards. A finite_field result boolean is trusted after its call. The phase4 log test only checks keys and padding count.
actual_cost: Includes reference FFTs, separate-frame scans and external finite-field work. Constant example coverage cannot establish asymptotic runtime or numerical stability.
assessment: The test names exact/reference do not make complex128 comparisons symbolic proofs. Merely finding a stored log is not source execution or source/result identity. sys.path mutation gives local modules precedence and needs explicit dependency hashes.

scope: Payload-byte and manifest membership verifier for the shear audit bundle; no theorem validation.
line_evidence: 4–9 root-relative hash/size checks; 10–11 file-set equality; 12–14 manifest self-hash check.
guards: Assumes honest, well-formed manifest paths; no traversal, symlink, duplicate-entry or schema rejection. Assertions can be disabled. Excludes exactly two seal filenames from membership comparison.
actual_cost: O(total listed payload bytes plus file enumeration); memory can hold the largest file and path set.
assessment: A matching seal establishes byte consistency only, never proof correctness, authorship or execution. We performed separately authored metadata hashing, not this script. Historical AST/test-definition counts in CHECK_RESULTS are not full-source credit by themselves.

scope: Seeded exact finite-field Green-Union audit with independently written innovation synthesis and a direct DFT reference; full output comparison for small sizes, selected bins at N=65536.
line_evidence: 20–51 raw recurrence fixture; 58–87 full-vector and random-input controls; 89–105 large selected-bin check and limitations; 106 output write.
guards: Clean first 2g rows, distinct scalar cosets and nondegenerate bases come from independent_audit helpers. Calls actual multishear_green_union for recognition/output. Parameters and field/root assumptions are fixed; not a standalone implementation-independent theorem.
actual_cost: Fixture recurrence enumerates 2^g−1 terms; direct full reference is O(N²); selected large reference O(N times number of selected bins). Production counters are model counters, not measured complete work.
assessment: A strong finite regression design with correct explicit limitations. Green helper import and reused primitive/root fixture helpers must remain in the dependency record; independence applies to reference construction, not absence of all source imports.

scope: Exact field tests of multiorbit and shear-gauge recovery from independently synthesized raw data and a direct DFT reference.
line_evidence: 19–67 root/nondegenerate/coset preparation; 70–113 independent generators; 121–168 full small cases and dense controls; 170–199 large spot checks and exclusions.
guards: N divides p−1, supplied p prime in chosen cases, clean/dense pilots, nonzero spectra and distinct cosets. Root search is exhaustive with no general complexity guarantee; nondegenerate search capped at 1000.
actual_cost: Reference O(N²) per full vector and O(N) per selected output. Fixture generation includes repeated modular exponentiation; coset search can range through p. Large output generation is complete but independent reference coverage is selected bins only.
assessment: No source execution here. Source-labeled independence accurately separates raw/reference formulas from implementation calls, but imported multishear, gauge and phase helpers prevent blanket independent dependency-closure credit.

scope: Recognized input-restricted Green extension: first 2g clean shear-orbit rows plus later innovations with total Fourier support R. Returns all N outputs only after deterministic raw-data reconstruction.
line_evidence: 50–61 subset recurrence; 64–107 clean pilot recovery; 110–158 recognition/reconstruction; 171–210 partial fractions and event output.
guards: Balanced Q,M; g>=1, Q>=2g, M>=g; nonnegative mode budget; invertible channel Hankel solves; exactly g distinct recovered shifts; distinct per-channel eigenvalues via Vandermonde solve and explicit denominator rejection. Primitive roots and sparse recognition are delegated. Public certificate constructors are not authenticated; transform_certified trusts their fields.
actual_cost: Pilot O(gM²+g³M) plus moment solves. Recurrence construction/application includes 2^g−1 subsets and O(2^g N), reconstruction adds O(MR); output O(gN+gQR), plus gN inverse tables and O(g²M) Green weights. Linear only for fixed g, balanced factors and R=O(Q); arbitrary large total_modes is accepted and enlarges cost.
assessment: Correctly scoped structural-family algorithm, not all-input FFT acceleration. raw_verification_terms=N is a position count, not all recurrence arithmetic; counters omit Hankel, subset, sparse-discovery and scalar-inversion work.

scope: Unknown-shift, unknown-scale sum of g dense shear orbits recognized from a 2g-row Hankel trace and then verified at every raw coordinate.
line_evidence: 72–104 guards/Hankel trace; 106–129 amplitude recovery and whole-input check; 136–159 geometric output and counters.
guards: Balance, Q>=2g, M>=g, distinct recovered shifts, nonsingular channel Hankel and Vandermonde systems. Root/primality assumptions delegated to phase helpers. q=0 reaches n%q before a positive-q check; forged certificates bypass recognition.
actual_cost: O(gM²+g³M+gN) plus moment solver and root preparation; g inversions tables cost O(gN), and all outputs O(gN). g is fixed in O_g(N); counters omit the g³M Hankel work and general inverse cost.
assessment: Full verification supports sound acceptance under dependencies, while degenerate valid orbit representations may be rejected. Cannot infer completeness for all sums of g orbits or apply the fixed-g bound when g grows.

scope: Spectral pair-majority recovers a shear/scalar gauge, then inherited Newton sparse-difference recognition and geometric-binomial output evaluate accepted inputs.
line_evidence: 30–56 radix sort; 69–149 discovery and majority; 152–175 inverse table; 200–213 recognition; 216–264 output.
guards: Recovery theorem assumes all first-row Fourier coefficients nonzero and fewer than M/4 corrupted frequencies. Implementation permits fewer observations but requires a strict majority of emitted candidates, followed by full delegated recognition. Q,M balanced; scalar inversion and primitive roots assumed/checked downstream. No finite-field primality oracle provided.
actual_cost: Pair records O(M²), radix passes ceil(log_M p), plus M modular inversions and O(M log M) unit-difference preparation. Claimed constant-pass word cost needs p=N^O(1). Output O_d(N+QR) plus delegated recognition and binomial kernels, only fixed d and R=O(Q) give linear behavior.
assessment: No universal or floating guarantee. inverse_for_scaled_roots error text mentions zero mu, but mu=0 actually gives all denominators 1 and is not rejected there; intended caller discovery supplies nonzero mu. Counter labels omit parts of discovery and inherited work.

scope: Multishear finite-field unit tests, with seeded synthesized fixtures, direct DFT comparison and nondegeneracy negative controls.
line_evidence: 10–34 parameter/fixture preparation; 38–63 solver/output tests; 65–90 strict-extension and degenerate rejections; 92–118 dense/root/large checks.
guards: Fixed tested primes and valid roots; scalar cosets and nonzero spectra intentionally arrange identifiability. Solver test conditionally accepts None, so not every sampled invertible matrix is independently confirmed invertible.
actual_cost: O(N²) direct reference on complete cases; sampled outputs at N=4096. Tests assert symbolic counter values rather than count every runtime operation. Fixture rejection sampling and field scanning are outside claimed production counters.
assessment: Finite extension examples are not general model separation proofs. Uses implementation synthesize_orbits and test_shear_gauge helpers, so it is not fully source-independent despite its header.

scope: Green innovation regression tests covering recurrence identities, full DFT outputs, zero-innovation agreement, bad pilot/late sample rejection and finite strict extensions.
line_evidence: 12–21 source fixture construction; 25–55 recurrence/full transforms; 57–86 extension and corruption controls; 88–109 dense/large checks.
guards: Fixed g=1..3, seeded fixtures, clean pilot and nondegenerate orbit choices; valid roots from shared helpers. Total_modes is raised to max(Q,R) for dense-event fixtures.
actual_cost: Full slow DFT comparisons are O(N²); N=4096 has only 15 reference bins. 2^g−1 recurrence terms and gQR outputs are explicit. Position-count counters do not certify an implementation-wide linear operation count.
assessment: Good finite tests of boundary cases, not executed now. Shared source fixtures and helpers limit independence; no growing-g, numerical stability or all-input correctness claim is certified.

scope: Shear-gauge tests for radix sorting, inverse tables, unknown gauge discovery, exact outputs, dense-orbit extension, bad roots and mixed factors.
line_evidence: 11–45 root/DFT/rank helpers; 48–63 fixtures; 66–114 tests; 116–177 full-rank and negative controls.
guards: Fixtures for d>1 force the first two gauged rows equal, ensuring a clean pilot; first-order corruptions stay below M/4 in explicit discovery tests. Nondegenerate baseline sampling contains an unbounded while loop. Root search assumes prime field in listed cases.
actual_cost: Dense direct reference O(N²); field-root search and fixture generation can dominate. Counters checked are selected terms only, not complete costs.
assessment: Correctly distinguishes mixed-length output from a simple Fourier-bin permutation. The one explicit full-rank family demonstrates failure of the old recognizer for that family, not a universal classification of all gauges.

scope: Universal expressivity at N=M² through M shear orbits with distinct multiplier cosets, with an explicitly superlinear construction.
line_evidence: 19–45 full row spectra, M Vandermonde systems and M inverse DFTs; 51–62 reconstruction cases and honest no-O(N) statement.
guards: Enough distinct subgroup cosets, exact primitive root, M invertible in the field and square input length. Root and solver dependencies are assumed. Field scanning for cosets is potentially costly.
actual_cost: Dense row and inverse transforms each O(M³)=O(N^(3/2)), plus M moment solves and synthesis O(MN)=O(N^(3/2)). It does not satisfy Q>=2g of the production 2g-pilot recognizer when Q=g=M.
assessment: Separately useful expressivity statement; no fast arbitrary-input executor. The displayed direct DFT check compares reconstructed x to already asserted equal x and is redundant, not an independent acceleration benchmark.

scope: Logarithmic union-bound estimate for fixed finite-field chirp family and supports up to r, not empirical coverage measurement.
line_evidence: 7–15 totient; 17–21 log-sum-exp formula; 25–29 chosen cases and JSON output.
guards: Assumes positive Q,M, M divides Q, 0<=r<=M and p>1 but does not validate them. math.comb/log fail on out-of-range inputs. Upper union bound may exceed one and is not probability-clamped.
actual_cost: Trial factorization O(sqrt(Q)) for each log term as written, r+1 binomial/log evaluations, arbitrary-precision integer binomial costs. No signal recovery occurs.
assessment: Analytic dimension counting under uniform finite-field input; cannot transfer to arbitrary distributions, complex measure or a deterministic all-input coverage assertion. Displayed exponents are floating approximations.

scope: Complex128 tolerance-based global sparse-phase prototype: discovers short-block modes, verifies block reconstruction to tolerance, then sums separate Green decoder outputs.
line_evidence: 38–53 input/phase setup; 55–74 discovery and tolerance decisions; 75–79 one decoder per discovered mode.
guards: Divisibility, K>=M, unit slope and 0<=max_modes<=M checked, but M=0, empty arrays, nonfinite input and invalid atol are not guarded. NaN comparisons at line 64 are false, permitting accepted=True with zero retained modes on NaN-contaminated data. No post-discovery reconstruction recheck after thresholding new modes.
actual_cost: O(M²) phase matrices, O(Qr) direct support projection/reconstruction, up to discovery-block short FFTs, and r separate Q-length Green decoders. Does not itself fuse all-M support into the O(QlogQ) complete-frame routine.
assessment: Must remain approximate and finite-input/tolerance scoped. Tolerance acceptance is not exact membership or a uniform output-error guarantee; production-safe API would reject NaN/Inf and validate positive factors. This is a static branch diagnosis, not an executed counterexample.

scope: Finite-field scaling audit for two prescribed sparse modes over eight sizes, comparing delegated adaptive output with a delegated reference.
line_evidence: 7–13 fixed workload and equality; 14–19 model counters and timing output.
guards: Relies entirely on phase6_exact wildcard imports for P, synthesis, operator counters, adaptive transform and oracle. No independent p/root or model validation in this file.
actual_cost: Time includes synthesized inputs outside the timed adaptive call, and times a separate reference whose true algorithm must be read independently. add+mult excludes uncounted divisions, allocations, control, preparation or bit complexity unless the dependency accounts for them.
assessment: root_generation_charged=True is written literally, not verified here. Stored seconds and per-input ratios are historical measurements, not fresh benchmarks or asymptotic proofs.

scope: Adversarial regression for disjoint block supports, late rejection, complete support, maximal Hankel rank and one complex disjoint-mode example.
line_evidence: 9–28 disjoint/late cases; 30–37 full support; 39–49 rank witnesses; 51–64 complex tolerance output.
guards: Fixed fields and factors inherited from phase6_exact; asserted support and Hankel claims depend on helpers. The complex case uses a tolerance and NumPy reference.
actual_cost: Hankel rank computations are dense, and full DFT references are external. The line-30 O(QlogQ) full-support comment must be checked against the exact dependency; this file proves no operation bound.
assessment: Useful tests of nonlocal support discovery and failure cost. Comment-level asymptotics cannot overwrite the actual decoder loop. No runtime checks were performed in this review.

scope: Seeded floating sparse-phase comparisons across eight factor pairs, three unit slopes/shifts and four support sizes, plus eight nonsparse rejection cases.
line_evidence: 9–22 successful cases and error normalization; 23–26 dense noise rejection; 27–33 recorded output.
guards: Membership uses atol=1e-8 for success cases, default tolerance for noise. Relative error normalized by max(1,||x||), not by ||F x|| infinity norm or smallest coefficient. No adversarial finite/near-threshold/NaN cases.
actual_cost: Includes full NumPy reference FFT and source synthesis. Repeated test costs say nothing about the all-M support production bound or preparation cost.
assessment: Finite floating regression only; errors do not provide a uniform forward/backward stability theorem. Shared dense_chirp_mode_example is not an independently synthesized exact-membership oracle.

scope: Exact-field regression over seven factor pairs, unit slopes, shifts and small supports, with random dense rejection and separate Hankel-rank measurements.
line_evidence: 8–27 all exact comparison cases; 28–33 rejection cases; 34–43 reported rank data/counters.
guards: Local wildcard phase6_exact dependency supplies every substantive algorithm and constant. Tests compare discovered modes and full outputs, but Hankel section only records ranks rather than asserts a universal rank formula.
actual_cost: Many full references and dense rank calculations; selected add/mult and butterfly counters omit unspecified operations. Counts are deterministic finite coverage.
assessment: Strong fixed-case regression design, not independent implementation-free proof or all-input transform guarantee. Unused support_tests variable has no substantive effect.

scope: Two-coordinate unitary gate entropy lower-bound illustration and finite radix-2 equality checks. Restriction excludes general arithmetic circuits and quantum qubit gates.
line_evidence: 2–7 model scope; 19–43 dense normalized butterfly matrix construction and entropy increments.
guards: N must be positive power of two; N=1 reaches max of an empty gate list. Entropy and Fourier equality are floating comparisons. General per-gate <=2-bit theorem is stated, not proved by tested radix-2 examples.
actual_cost: Stores a dense N² matrix; recomputes full-matrix entropy twice per gate for N log N gates, O(N³ log N) diagnostic work and O(N²) matrix memory.
assessment: Do not confuse the witness checker with an O(NlogN) implementation or apply this restricted lower bound to unrestricted exact FFT complexity.

scope: Six-script fail-fast regression launcher and timing/log-tail recorder.
line_evidence: 5 listed scripts; 8–14 subprocess execution and historical result write.
guards: check=True reports child exit failure, no timeout; inherits environment and interpreter, so child assertions can be disabled through PYTHONOPTIMIZE. Captures full child output before retaining only last 300 characters.
actual_cost: Entire child workloads, including dense references and entropy-matrix controls; timing is per script, not production transform-only work.
assessment: Would execute supplied programs if run; it was inertly read. A launcher PASS and truncated stdout are not exact-hash whole-source review or proof of which dependency versions ran.

scope: Exact N=4 weighted two-resolvent Fourier identity with external gauges, followed by a noncommuting three-mixer exceptional point.
line_evidence: 9–49 custom eight-dimensional rational algebra; 57–88 two-resolvent identities and guards; 92–140 three-mixer/rational congruences.
guards: q^4=-1 and d²=2−4q² arithmetic, Gaussian inversions by exact rational elimination. Explicit alpha/beta/residue/cycle guards and normalization. Assumes coefficient tuples length eight and invertible multiplication matrices; malformed/singular data can raise rather than certify. Algebra embedding/irreducibility is a mathematical precondition not proved by class E.
actual_cost: Fixed 8-coordinate algebra and 4x4 dense matrices; inversions solve 8x8 rational systems. Arbitrary-size bit growth is uncharged by nominal field operations; finite N=4 only.
assessment: The N>=5 rational growth obstruction is an output sentence, not verified by this executable. Weighted/gauged model differs from unweighted unit-diagonal sums. No uniform algorithm or novelty follows from this exception.

scope: Exact finite-field determinant and q-difference checks for truncated joint-orbit kernels across eleven chosen M values.
line_evidence: 5 dynamically executes sibling check_joint_orbit.py if run; 18–39 field selection, sequence, recurrence and determinant formula.
guards: Every denominator 1−q^r must be nonzero, ensured by intended root-order setup in external helper rather than explicit assertion before inversion. Prime field and adequate root order depend on sibling. Input Hankel matrices are square and sampled index limits keep sequence accesses valid.
actual_cost: For each h,ell,n, dense n³ determinant elimination plus product formula and modular exponentiation; summing these loops gives polynomial verification far above a linear transform.
assessment: Header independence does not mean absence of source execution: runtime explicitly imports and executes the sibling, potentially with top-level side effects. No such import occurred here; stored determinant counts are historical, not freshly reproduced.

scope: Exploratory ranks of the full kernel table for M=2..44 in finite fields selected by check_joint_orbit.py.
line_evidence: 3–4 dynamic sibling execution; 17–27 sequence table, elimination and result output.
guards: p/root setup delegated; inverse factorial-like products require all factors nonzero. rank assumes nonempty rectangular input; chosen matrices are square. This script never asserts any expected rank pattern.
actual_cost: O(M³) Gaussian elimination per M plus O(M²) coefficient construction with modular powers/inversions; field discovery can add significant cost.
assessment: A stored list of ranks is exploratory evidence only, not a proof of generic/full rank for every M. Dynamic source dependency and source/result pairing remain separate from complete inert review of this exact hash.
